CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JANUARY 30, 2024
  4901 E. CARSON STREET
  LONG BEACH CITY COLLEGE
  LIBERAL ARTS CAMPUS BUILDING T, ROOM 1100, 5:00 PM

Kathleen Irvine, Chair  Tasha Hunter, Commissioner
Kevin McGuan, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CULTURAL.HERITAGE@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE CLICK ON THE LINK BELOW TO VIEW A MAP OF THE MEETING LOCATION AND
  PARKING INFORMATION
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH.GOV/GLOBALASSETS/CITY-CLERK/MEDIA-
  LIBRARY/DOCUMENTS/LBCC-MAP

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51915  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-51916  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, November 28, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-51954  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow the demolition of a
  single building consisting of a detached garage and storage room; construction of
  a 369 square foot first floor addition; construction of a new 503 square foot second
  floor to the rear of a single-story residence and a new detached 700 square foot
  two-car garage. The property is located at 335 Gladys Avenue, within the Bluff
  Heights Historic District and in the Two-Family Residential District with Standard
  Lots (R-2-A) Zoning District. The property is a Contributor to the Bluff Heights
  Historic District. (District 2)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-51965  Approve recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt

  Page 1 of 2
   CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JANUARY 30, 2024
  4901 E. CARSON STREET
  LONG BEACH CITY COLLEGE
  LIBERAL ARTS CAMPUS BUILDING T, ROOM 1100, 5:00 PM

  the proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to construct a new one-
  story 159-square-foot addition, and new 653-square-foot second-story addition and
  a one-story 10-square-foot demolition to the existing residence, subject to
  Conditions. The property is located at 2920 E. Vista Street within the R-2-A Zoning
  District and is a Contributor to the Bluff Heights Historic District. (District 2)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-51966  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to construct a new one-story
  478-square-foot addition to side and rear of the existing residence, subject to
  Conditions. The property is located at 3618 Rose Avenue within the R-1-N Zoning
  District and is a Contributor to the California Heights Historic District. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Aprove recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101.
